# Data Science Academia

> Data Science Academia is a Ph.D.-led AI & Data Science institute in Chennai offering 18 courses (Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, LLMs, Power BI, Azure, AWS), AICTE-aligned internships, Microsoft certification prep and a 12-month AI Mastery Track — live in Chennai and online.

Address: 2nd Floor, Arasan Complex, No. 69, Grand Southern Trunk Road, West Tambaram, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600045, India. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 91764 98814. Email: info@datascienceacademia.in. Hours: Mon – Sat · 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST. Founded 2019; MSME registered; AICTE-aligned internships and FDPs.

## DSA Code Champs levels

- [Code Explorers](https://ajaymukund.github.io/datascienceacademia/codechamps/explorers.html): Level 1 - Grade 3 – 5 - Ages 8 – 10 - 3 Months, 24 Sessions.
- [Code Builders](https://ajaymukund.github.io/datascienceacademia/codechamps/builders.html): Level 2 - Grade 6 – 7 - Ages 11 – 12 - 3 Months, 24 Sessions.
- [Code Innovators](https://ajaymukund.github.io/datascienceacademia/codechamps/innovators.html): Level 3 - Grade 8 – 9 - Ages 13 – 14 - 4 Months, 32 Sessions.
- [Code Pioneers](https://ajaymukund.github.io/datascienceacademia/codechamps/pioneers.html): Level 4 - Grade 10 – 12 - Ages 15 – 17 - 6 Months, 48 Sessions.
